# sha256 of its snapshot's binary face. `harness/golden-2d.sh` regenerates the sweep and
# `scripts/orch/rows/p12-t4b.rows`'s `golden-2d` row diffs it against this file.
#
# Provenance: `harness/golden-2d.sh` run on develop f1a2dd4 (2026-10-03), before
# p12-t4b was merged into it. The first pin (2026-10-02) was taken on an older develop
# whose 2D bytes have since moved for recorded reasons, so it could not tell a merge
# regression from develop's own history. Every line below is develop's output; the
# `golden-2d` row passing means the merge moved no 2D byte.

# belongs in docs/measurements/p12-t4b.md before the pin is rewritten.
